description: Get one building’s record from Umarelli: building permits, assessed value and property tax bill, tax breaks, zoning, and news coverage. The id is a New York City BBL (ten digits), a Jersey City id such as jc:14106:39, or an Umarelli building URL.

id.description: A building id from search, a BBL, or a building URL

name: fetch
title: Get a building’s record
